meta.description: Misconception remediation paths for Unit 4 practice MCQs

right_left_hand_rule_swap.feedback: Right-hand thumb rule finds B from current. Fleming's left-hand rule finds force on a conductor in B.
right_left_hand_rule_swap.calm_prompt: RH thumb = B; left hand = F.

field_lines_cross_or_open.feedback: Magnetic field lines are closed curves and never cross. Direction = motion of a free north pole.

domestic_series_wiring_error.feedback: Home appliances are in parallel across live and neutral so each gets 220 V and works independently.

straight_wire_field_pattern_error.feedback: Field around a straight current-carrying wire forms concentric circles, not radial or parallel lines.

short_circuit_overload_confusion.feedback: Short circuit: live touches neutral. Overload: too much load or voltage surge. Both raise current; fuse melts.
